Rule: Order ID must not be missing
Order ID must be unique according to the data dictionary
Order date must use YYYY-MM-DD format
Date must be between 2025-01-01 and today
Segment must be Student, Fresher, or Professional
Category must match the documented allowed values
Quantity must be a positive number
Discount must be present and between 0 and 100
Payment status must be Paid or Pending
